selection_semantics.boolean_counterfactual: recomputed from event jet predicate and per-vertex atomic predicates
selection_semantics.vertex_combination: event passes DV selection iff at least one vertex passes every enabled DV cut
selection_semantics.response_counterfactual: not defined; response weighting remains the published baseline operation
selection_semantics.geometry: truth LLP decay vertices plus smeared recast jet axes; not reconstructed detector hits
selection_semantics.tracks: charged final recursive LLP daughters; straight truth/recast directions only; selected_for_dv exactly records beta*gamma*tau > 520 mm and pT/|q| > 1 GeV
selection_semantics.d0: signed proxy exactly serialized from r_prod * sin(phi_prod - phi_track)
